title: GTA6 Ultimate Edition Proves Popular Among Pre-orders
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick reveals that many players pre-ordering GTA6 are opting for the more expensive Ultimate edition over the standard one.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Pre-orders Show Strong Demand for Higher-Priced Ultimate Edition

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, pricing strategies have consistently been a hot topic of discussion. While the prospect of paying higher prices for modern AAA titles often sparks debate among players, recent insights from Rockstar parent company Take-Two suggest that consumer behavior might defy expectations.

According to Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Take-Two, many people who baulked at the idea of paying higher prices for a game have actually done the opposite when it comes to the checkout page. Rather than opting for the $80 (£70) Standard edition, a significant portion of those who pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto 6 have chosen to buy the more expensive Ultimate edition, which hits the $100 (£90) mark.

### A Closer Look at Pre-order Trends

The pricing structure—featuring the $80 standard tier and the $100 ultimate tier—had previously raised questions about market resistance. However, Zelnick's revelations indicate that dedicated fans are more than willing to open their wallets wider for the ultimate package. This robust demand for the premium version highlights the immense pulling power of the franchise and the unwavering loyalty of its player base.

Ultimately, this trend demonstrates that for generational blockbusters like GTA6, a large segment of the audience prioritizes getting the definitive edition, price tag notwithstanding.

## Editor's Take

The revelation that a large share of GTA6 pre-orders leans toward the $100 Ultimate edition rather than the standard tier highlights the incredible brand loyalty surrounding Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece. It suggests that for elite-tier franchises, pricing friction may be far lower than anticipated among core enthusiasts who want the complete package on day one.
